Root cause (turn-scoped tool-restriction propagation into subagents vs. some other cause) is not yet isolated.

The Implementation phase's one-and-only transport-repair budget was spent on the Markdown-fence issue in this run; any further transport failure in a retried Implementation phase would have to block immediately with no correction available.

Quality Engineer dispatch remains unexercised in this run (a live dispatch against a blocked implementation report was judged to add no new evidence over existing boundary-test verification, so it was intentionally skipped rather than attempted and discarded).

Re-run /work with the same free-form request (or resume this exact run's Implementation phase in a genuinely new user turn, since the restriction is documented as turn-scoped) once the tool-restriction-propagation finding above is resolved, to reach ready_for_verification and dispatch a live Quality Engineer for the first time.
